LanguageData.Gun_AK-102_RWP.description: The AK-102 is a modern assault rifle known for its reliability and adaptability. It fires 5.56x39mm rounds, offering a balance of high accuracy and significant stopping power over medium distances. Ideal for both mid-range combat and quick assaults, this weapon is favored by many for its durability and ease of maintenance in harsh environments.
